facts.business: Relaxo Footwears Limited is the largest footwear manufacturer in India, offering brands such as Relaxo, Flite, Sparx, and Bahamas across various consumer segments.
key_risks: Delayed filing of e-form with Registrar of Companies
No formal product take-back or end-of-life recycling program
Does not track percentage of sustainably sourced inputs
Write down of inventories to net realisable value increased to Rs 5.05 crore from Rs 0.38 crore
facts.related_party_note: There are no advances given to promoters, directors, KMPs and related parties. There are no trade receivables due by promoters, directors, KMPs and related parties.
